system.description:
Action
Ritual · 1 minute
SP
1
Attribute
None
Range
One adjacent corpse
Duration
24 hours

Preserve the body from ordinary decay. Time under Gentle Repose still counts toward any spell's stated resurrection deadline; preservation keeps the remains suitable for examination or rites.
